{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(sales.dtypes)
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(sales.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f'\nNumber of rows with customer_age == -1: {(sales["customer_age"] == -1).sum()}')

# Check for revenue format
print(f'\nSample of revenue values:')
print(sales["revenue"].head(10))

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
print(f'\nNumber of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {(sales["revenue"] == "999999.99").sum()}')

# Check for refunded orders
print(f'\nNumber of refunded orders: {(sales["status"] == "refunded").sum()}')"}
